title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
author: Douglas Adams
summary: Seconds before the Earth is demolished to make way for a galactic freeway, Arthur Dent is plucked off the planet by his friend Ford Prefect, a researcher for the revised edition of The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy who, for the last fifteen years, has been posing as an out-of-work actor.
personalThoughts: Absolutely hilarious. Changed my perspective on sci-fi forever.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
summary: Set on the desert planet Arrakis, Dune is the story of the boy Paul Atreides, heir to a noble family tasked with ruling an inhospitable world where the only thing of value is the 'spice' melange.
favoriteQuote: I must not fear. Fear is the mind-killer.
personalThoughts: Dense but incredible world-building. The politics are fascinating.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
summary: Ryland Grace is the sole survivor on a desperate, last-chance mission—and if he fails, humanity and the earth itself will perish.

title: Neuromancer
author: William Gibson
summary: Case was the sharpest data-thief in the matrix—until he crossed the wrong people and they crippled his nervous system.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
summary: Told in Kvothe's own voice, this is the tale of the magically gifted young man who grows to be the most notorious wizard his world has ever seen.
favoriteQuote: It's like everyone tells a story about themselves inside their own head.
personalThoughts: Beautiful prose, the magic system is deeply logical.

title: Moby Dick
author: Herman Melville
summary: The narrative of the voyage of the whaling ship Pequod, commanded by Captain Ahab, who leads his crew on a hunt for the great white whale Moby Dick.
personalThoughts: Too many chapters about whale anatomy. Lost interest.
